mapper.select: SELECT c.id customer_id,c.customer_code code,c.customer_name name,c.contact_name,c.contact_phone,c.status, p.address,p.country,p.email,p.preferred_currency,p.business_owner,COALESCE(p.revision,0) revision, COALESCE(p.updated_at,c.updated_at) updated_at FROM bike_customer c LEFT JOIN bike_customer_profile p ON p.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM bike_customer WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
